info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Sub Custodian Agreement Management API
info.description: The Sub Custodian Agreement Management API facilitates the creation and management of agreements with external agencies acting as sub custodians. This API allows financial institutions to onboard and configure sub custodian partnerships efficiently, ensuring compliance with legal and operational standards. Typical consumers include banking institutions and investment firms looking to streamline custodial operations and monitor agreement terms. With a focus on enhancing asset management and operational transparency, this API supports critical functions in the financial services ecosystem.
